palette: dark furnace iron, riveted parchment panels, copper pipes, gauge vermilion, brass plates, steam blue accents
typography: WenKai boiler-room headings with rivet chips and pressure dial cards
composition: an ascending five-rung pressure ladder with an organ-dial bay, a bail condition board flanked by guarantor and deposit banks, and a triple gauge board closing into a review strip
surface: an industrial boiler room with riveted iron plates, copper framing and parchment instrument panels
motion: ladder rungs rise step by step toward arrest, condition banks fill their chips, and the arrest file chip travels from the request to the release rule
transition: the furnace backdrop and copper frame persist while the instrument panels are replaced
